# stalwart_mta_inbound_throttle (Data Source)

Defines an inbound rate limit rule for SMTP connections.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Short description for the throttle
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether to enable this throttle
- `key` (Set of String) Optional list of context variables that determine where this throttle should be applied
- `match` (Attributes) Enable the imposition of concurrency and rate limits only when a specific condition is met (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `rate` (Attributes) Number of incoming requests over a period of time that the rate limiter will allow (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate))

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Read-Only:

- `else` (String) Else condition
- `match` (Attributes List) List of conditions and their corresponding results (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match--match))

### Nested Schema for `match.match`

Read-Only:

- `if` (String) If condition
- `then` (String) Then clause



<a id="nestedatt--rate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) Count
- `period` (Number) Period
